opaque.behavior_summary: Selected a full 2x2 solvent/electrolyte factorial at fixed process controls and inferred a strong interaction.

aligned_nominal.behavior_summary: Used the nominal dossier to choose E1/S0, challenged it with a high-forcing E3/S3 condition, then returned to and replicated the best observed E1/S0 recipe.

misindexed_nominal.behavior_summary: Began moderately trusting the blinded dossier, reduced trust after contradictory outcomes, isolated E1/S0 as the best observed condition, and ended with explicit suspicion of both prior fields without fully rejecting the dossier.
